description: This file defines the ItemAdapter class for an Android application, specifically for a notes app. It manages the display of different item types (sections and notes) in a RecyclerView, including view holder creation, binding, selection handling, and styling.

classes.name: ItemAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing and displaying a list of items (sections and notes) in a RecyclerView, supporting multiple view types, selection, and styling.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item at the given position, used for stable ID management.

methods.name: setItemList
methods.description: Updates the internal list of items and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder instances based on view type and layout (grid or list).

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, managing selection states and styling.

methods.name: setTracker
methods.description: Sets the SelectionTracker for managing item selection.

methods.name: isMultiSelect
methods.description: Returns whether multi-selection mode is active.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the item at the specified position.

methods.name: hasItemPosition
methods.description: Checks if the given position is within the bounds of the item list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified item from the list.

methods.name: setShowCategory
methods.description: Sets whether to display category information.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type for the item at a given position based on its content.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies a color branding to the adapter's items.

methods.name: setHighlightSearchQuery
methods.description: Highlights search query matches within items.

methods.name: getFirstPositionOfViewType
methods.description: Finds the first position of a specific view type.

methods.name: getSwipedPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the currently swiped item, if any.

methods.name: setSwipedPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the currently swiped item.
